verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring work is a fair question for an autonomous personal assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only proactive behavior the agent initiates itself (following up on dropped threads, nudging, booking an overdue appointment) and one-off tasks like rides, reservations and calls. Nothing shows a user-defined recurring schedule or repeating workflow, and agent-initiated proactivity is an adjacent behavior, not scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
